agent_instructions: Coordinator: assign one worker per character with its rows manifest and reference image.
Worker: process rows sequentially, making one separate image-generation call per row.
Attach reference_image to every call. Use shared_prompt plus only the current row's prompt, facing and loop setting.
Save each strip to its output_image path, relative to this manifest. Generate all six frames of that row together; never combine different rows in one call.
shared_prompt: Using this reference, generate one six-frame animation strip in a single row. Match the character design, proportions and art style throughout. Equal cells, consistent scale and ground line, full body and weapon visible. Transparent background; no checkerboard, labels or grid lines.

rows.prompt: A complete two-step walking cycle, both legs taking a turn.
A complete two-step running cycle, both legs taking a turn.
One heavy gauntlet punch, from anticipation through recovery.
Raise both gauntlets and summon golden shield energy.
React to a hit, recoil, then end kneeling.
Walking away, viewed from behind; a complete two-step cycle.
Walking toward the viewer; a complete two-step cycle.
